prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 版本更新日志（中英混排） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "版本" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 43px
  col 2: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "变更内容" · longest unbreakable word 90px · one-line width 646px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，供读者查看版本演进。","reading":"读者可先按版本或日期定位，再扫描类型和变更内容；同一行的元数据与说明需要保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["版本与日期共同标识一次发布，适合并置比较。","类型与变更内容共同说明更新性质；类型是短标签，内容是主要阅读区域。"],"keep_intact":["版本号及其字母、数字和标点","日期中的数字片段","WebSocket、OAuth、OpenSSL 等英文术语及版本号","修复、新功能、性能、安全等类型标签宜尽量保持完整"],"may_wrap":["变更内容可在中文词句及英文术语之间自然换行。","日期可在连字符处换行，但会降低纵向扫描效率。","内容说明形成的行高可容纳同一行中类型或日期的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [64, 80, 67, 148] · table 360×485px · row heights [36, 106, 153, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [64, 72, 55, 168] · table 360×461px · row heights [36, 106, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [64, 108, 55, 132] · table 360×578px · row heights [36, 129, 176, 129, 106] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"版本号和类型标签保持完整，四列表头清晰；类型与说明的对应关系容易辨认。","problems":"日期分成两行，降低了纵向比较效率；变更内容偏窄，较长说明形成密集的六行文本。","cause":"日期列的80px不足以容纳完整日期；类型列67px能容纳三个汉字，但内容列只剩148px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"内容列较宽，说明的换行更自然，长行的阅读节奏优于r1A；版本号保持完整。","problems":"“新功能”被拆成两行，削弱了类型列作为短标签的扫描作用；日期仍分成两行。","cause":"类型列55px只有34px的文本空间，容不下三个汉字；日期列72px不足以容纳完整日期。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"完整日期排列整齐，便于逐行比较；版本号也保持完整。","problems":"内容列过窄，说明被切成许多短行，表格明显拉长；“新功能”仍被拆开，长英文术语和标识符周围的换行也显得拥挤。","cause":"日期列占用108px后，内容列只剩132px；类型列55px不足以容纳三个汉字。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-labels","widths":[64,72,66,157],"change":"以r1B为基础，把类型列加宽至66px以完整容纳“新功能”，其余空间留给内容；保留日期在连字符处换行。"},{"name":"content-priority","widths":[64,64,66,165],"change":"进一步收窄日期列，把空间交给内容列，同时保持版本号和类型标签完整；观察较窄日期列是否仍能形成清晰的两行日期。"},{"name":"date-compromise","widths":[64,80,66,149],"change":"保留r1A较宽的日期列，并将类型列调整到刚好容纳三个汉字；与内容优先方案比较日期列留白和说明换行的视觉节奏。"}]}
